intro: Gazin Tenorm is a dwarf stationed near the altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Alongside his comrade Henze Faulk, he undertook a dangerous scouting mission to gather evidence of Defias Brotherhood activity for the king's advisors.

p: While Gazin Tenorm spends his days within the tranquil halls of the Cathedral of Light, his mind remains out in the wilds of Elwynn Forest. Gazin and his close friend Henze Faulk set out into the woods on an urgent errand: gathering hard proof of the Defias Brotherhood's movements to present before the royal court. The expedition went awry when they were ambushed by Defias forces. Gazin barely escaped with his life back to the safety of Stormwind, but Henze was left behind in mortal danger, prompting Gazin to seek a stalwart hero of the Light to come to his companion's aid.
